label: copy-phase update gate: input r/i/l/s/y late in the copy, or any copy step when L=3
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L). It never fires in the original phase or on <DEL>, and never on recall_idx 0. Two things drive it. (1) Which token is fed back as input: r, i, l, s, y fire on 13-22% of their copy steps (4x lift), x/a/n less often, d/o rarely. (2) Position: it is active on about 90% of copy steps in L=3 sequences, and in longer sequences mostly near the end (to_go 0-1 carries 61% of the mass) but almost never when to_go >= 6. The strongest activations are at step L+2 of L=3 sequences when the input is r/i/s. The predicate gets dev F1 0.54 and mass recall 0.73. Many r/i/l/s/y copy steps stay inactive, and other tokens near the end of the copy also fire, so precision and recall are both incomplete.
